svg.title: Suragu — Blood of the Caldera. Draft 2 / Lava classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Magma Vein forks into Scalding Tide then Pyroclastic Surge, or Clinging Slag then The Mountain Wakes. Cooling Crust forks into Igneous Shell then Heart of the Caldera, or Molten Draught then Unquenchable Furnace. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Lava-classified Suragu jutsu.

Lava Wave (40 AP ground circle) holds the kit's two self buffs, IDG 35% and DDT 30%, and anchors the tank route; Eruption Strike's Afterburn 35% (circle on the enemy, ally hazard) is the opt-in pressure route, and Blow of Devastation's IDT 35% is the cheap D-rank exposure that glues the offense Foundation together. Every percentage tag is a single row: DDT and Afterburn take Taiyo Kami's single-row +10, IDG and IDT stay at +5 as glue, Lifesteal +10 is set by the 60% leech budget; Damage reaches two rows, one mode-restricted, so it stays at +5 (user decision, design note 6)."},"nodes":[{"id":"01","name":"Magma Vein","category":"Foundation","cost":1,"parents":[],"modifiers":[{"tag":"increasedamagegiven","flat":2,"display_role":"SELF BUFF"},{"tag":"increasedamagetaken","flat":2,"display_role":"ENEMY DEBUFF"}],"flavor":"The mountain's blood runs in Suragu veins, and it does not cool.","coverage_note":"IDG 35% on Lava Wave (self, at cast, 2 rounds, not tied to the circle) -> 37%; IDT 35% on Blow of Devastation (enemy, 2 rounds) -> 37%.","parent_rule":"ALL","potency_classification":"Lava","scope":"Suragu jutsu","minimum_path_bp":1,"coverage":{"jutsu":["Blow of Devastation","Lava Wave"],"effect_rows":2}},{"id":"02","name":"Scalding Tide","category":"Hidden Art","cost":1,"parents":["01"],"modifiers":[{"tag":"damage","flat":2,"display_role":"DAMAGE"}],"flavor":"What the tide touches, it takes; what it leaves behind still smokes.","coverage_note":"Damage on Infernal Stream 40 -> 42 and Magma Slayer 45 -> 47 (PVP only); both 60 AP Lava hits. IDG and IDT sit only on Magma Vein and as capstone secondaries, never on a Hidden Art, and each capstone secondary stays below the Hidden Art flat on its tag (Pyroclastic Surge +2 LS under Molten Draught +3; Unquenchable Furnace +2 DDT under Igneous Shell +3): all 14 full builds non-dominated, every node used.","Calibration: the 7 supported rows were split by finished build, not copied by rank: burst (Damage +5 on 2 rows, one PVP-only), burn (AB +10), tank (DDT +10), leech (LS +10), IDG/IDT +5 as glue; the Taiyo node shape fits because Suragu has the same four single-row roles. Versus Taiyo: DDT and AB +10 equal its single-row maxima; IDT +5 sits under its +7; IDG +5 equals its two-row ceiling on one row; LS +10 has no Taiyo precedent; the 60% leech budget sets it. Top build 24 on 7 rows vs 31 on 9.","Passives and main tree: the bloodline IDG passive (25% + 0.15/level on Lava, Earth, Fire, None) multiplies enhanced Damage rows. Lava Wave's IDG row is SELF, realized on the caster at cast for 2 rounds wherever they stand; it lists Earth, Fire, Lava and None, so it also raises basic attacks, weapons and element-less jutsu. Its DDT row and Blow's IDT row are element-less, so they apply to every non-pierce hit. Lifesteal counts pierce while its buff is up; AB, IDG, IDT, DDT skip pierce.","Delivery and uptime: every jutsu has a 7-round cooldown; none is item-gated or hidden. Lava Wave (40 AP ground circle, range 5): its IDG row is SELF, on the caster at cast; only the DDT row is a ground effect (INHERIT, friendly fire FRIENDLY), re-applied each round to the caster and allies on the circle from the round after it lands (move row sorts last). Infernal Stream, Magma Slayer: 60 AP singles, Eruption Strike a 60 AP enemy circle, Blow 40 AP. Ranked PVP/ranked sparring skip the tree.","Fourth-purchase choices: after any 3-BP route the natural fourth is the other Foundation. Unadvertised legal builds include 01+02+04+05 (the strongest burn: +2 Damage, +10 Afterburn, +5 IDT, +5 IDG, no mitigation or leech), 01+02+03+04 (burst with 3% Afterburn), 06+07+08+09 (pure fortress: +10 DDT, +5 Lifesteal, +3 IDG) and 06+07+09+10 (tank-sustain: +10 Lifesteal, +7 DDT). No-capstone hybrids such as 01+02+06+09 (+2 Damage, +5 Lifesteal, +2 IDG/IDT/DDT) are legal and non-dominated.","Four examples because each capstone answers a different role with its own Advanced Art; the pressure route's value is downstream. USER DECISION: Damage ceiling +5 (Pyroclastic Surge +3) or +6 (+4). As drafted the burst route is the lowest-value capstone at depth 3: in PVE it is +5 on one 40-power, 60 AP, 7-cooldown row (+12.5%) plus LS +2, while sibling capstones add +10 to their rows; +6 (guardrail max) gives PVE +15%. The +2 LS stays either way. Also open: +3 IDG on Mountain Wakes; LS cap 50%."],"risks":["Classification: Lava is the kit's single signature element (Magma Slayer and Infernal Stream Damage, Eruption Strike pierce) but is not exclusive in the census: Amaterasu [DEFER] carries Lava on 3 rows (2 damage). The label therefore has to be bloodline-scoped under the proposed whole-kit classification, not a bare element match. Whether any non-bloodline jutsu carries Lava is unverified.","Resolver: 4 of 7 supported rows (DDT, IDT, Afterburn, Lifesteal) carry no element and fall back to None under the current resolver; affectedElements=['Lava'] matches only Lava Wave IDG and the two Damage rows directly. Reaching the rest today needs None, which also reaches every non-elemental row on any jutsu the player casts. The tree assumes the proposed whole-kit classification.","Ally hazard (validator warns): Eruption Strike row 1 Afterburn (AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN on the enemy, friendly fire none) is raised by Clinging Slag and The Mountain Wakes; allies standing in that circle also receive the enhanced burn, so positioning decides; the caster is never a target of an OTHER_USER circle. The route is opt-in: no Foundation touches Afterburn; the other three builds never raise it.","Mode restriction: Magma Slayer (Damage 45, wound) is PVP-only, so in PVE the Damage route reaches only Infernal Stream and the +5 ceiling is +12.5% on a single 40-power row, the lowest-value capstone at depth 3 in that mode. The route was weighted accordingly (+5 rather than +6, Lifesteal secondary on the capstone); the +5 vs +6 ceiling is the user decision recorded in design note 6.","Lifesteal: the route tops out at 50%, ten points under the 60%-of-pre-shield-damage leech budget shared with vamp; vamp from the normal tree or items can saturate the cap and waste part of the +10. It needs both combatants alive and is blocked by healprevent on the caster. The buff is a 2-round self effect from a 60 AP cast, so uptime depends on the 7-round cooldown.","Afterburn: the +10 route is one application row on a 60 AP cast whose own damage is pierce (58) and never feeds the burn; the kit holds only two instant Damage rows (one PVP-only) that can, so the route's value rests on weapons, normal jutsu and allies hitting the one burning enemy for two rounds, capped at 60% of each hit. Not simulated.","Stacking: BATTLE_TAG_STACKING is true at the pin, so these potency effects stack with any other potency source; the combined budget with a future normal-tree potency policy is unaudited. The bloodline IDG passive multiplies the enhanced Damage rows and Lava Wave's IDG at 40% raises Infernal Stream's hit and therefore its leech; neither was modelled.","No combat simulation: non-dominance of the 14 allocations and the row-weighted totals are arithmetic over per-row additions, not evidence of equal combat strength. Lava Wave's DDT tile uptime, Blow of Devastation's recoil, Magma Slayer's wound, Infernal Stream's poison, Eruption Strike's pierce and AP economy were not modelled. No adverse, hidden, item-gated or injected rows exist in this kit."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":10,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":4,"advanced_art_count":4,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":5,"3":10,"4":14},"full_budget_allocations":14,"non_dominated_full_allocations":14,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":5,"decreasedamagetaken":10,"afterburn":10,"lifesteal":10},"supported_rows_in_kit":7,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"afterburn":1,"damage":2,"decreasedamagetaken":1,"increasedamagegiven":1,"increasedamagetaken":1,"lifesteal":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["afterburn","damage","decreasedamagetaken","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken","lifesteal"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 2 / Lava classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.","All existing supported tags of Suragu jutsu inherit Lava potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.","Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). g.text: Draft 2 / Lava classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Suragu jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
The Mountain Wakes path + Cooling Crust
Heart of the Caldera path + Magma Vein
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · AB: Afterburn · LS: Lifesteal
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Afterburn is an enemy debuff: while it lasts, damage the target takes adds Afterburn damage at the debuff percentage (60% cap per hit).
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
